The panel keeps one general chat st"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ream where messages can carry several topic tags; topics act as task-dispatch cues and untagged mess"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"ages are left for Superagent to decide. Without that prototype, the plugin falls back to a single ge"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"Superagent to decide. Without that prototype, the plugin falls back to a single general DSH Session."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What this repository is"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **A Super Chat plugin for dsh-superagent-prototype**: its core is a `super-chat` Source that turns"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" chat messages into Tickets; it also provides one tagged chat stream, SQLite storage and topic-filte"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"red views.
- **Superagent Tickets**: the plugin connects through the prototype's public `orchestrato"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"r` service; acknowledgements and results return to the same stream. Prototype code is not modified; "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"a single general DSH Session is the fallback when the prototype is absent.
- **`wechat/`**: an optio"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"nal WeChat File Transfer Helper bridge. It defaults to the general chat and uses `@topic` to tag mes"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"Chat File Transfer Helper bridge. It defaults to the general chat and uses `@topic` to tag messages."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **All messages**: every message goes into one stream; this is the panel's main view and replaces t"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"he former "General chat" label. The panel opens at the newest page and loads older messages when you"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" scroll up.
- **<No topic> view**: shows only messages that carry no tags, with a live count in the "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"sidebar; it is a read-time filter and changes neither storage, dispatch nor the topic list.
- **Topi"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"c views**: topics are tags on messages, not separate conversations. One message may carry several ta"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"gs and appears in every matching view.
- **Topics are dispatch cues**: for a tagged message the firs"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"t tag becomes the `super-chat` dispatch thread; untagged messages go to `general` and Superagent dec"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ides. Tags never force the outcome.
- **Auto-tagging**: the general chat's header labels untagged me"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ssages with existing topics through the profile's default model; only empty tags are filled, agent r"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"eplies inherit them, and no topics are created.
- **Manual tag editing**: each message's tag row can"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" add or remove tags and save; only that message changes, a new name creates a topic, and no work is "},{"id":"p8s12","text":"dispatched.
- **Markdown replies**: agent replies render common Markdown (headings, lists, quotes, l"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"inks, fenced and inline code); each reply has a **Raw** button that switches it back to the original"},{"id":"p8s14","text":" text. User messages stay as authored.
- **Model settings**: the composer's **Models** entry, immedi"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"ately left of **Send**, chooses the orchestrator model and the default model for new workers from th"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"e profile catalog. A chat message such as `用 gemini-4-argon 模型启动一个新 worker 做…` or `use gemini-4-argo"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"n model to start a new worker for…` gives that one new worker the named model without changing the d"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"efault.
- **Superagent Tickets**: acknowledgements, answers and results come back with their tags. A"},{"id":"p8s19","text":" chat-only prototype with no GitHub repository or CLI can still take work.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- DSH **0.2.1-rc.5** or a compatible `0.2.x` Web profile (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/ds"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"h-web-app`).
- Node.js 22.19+ or 24+.
- A model provider configured in the profile, as for any norma"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" Node.js 22.19+ or 24+.
- A model provider configured in the profile, as for any normal DSH Session."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- A message id deduplicates retries; the same submission never opens a second Ticket.
- A topic view"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" filters the one stream by tag. It does not copy messages or create separate storage.
- For tagged m"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"essages the Superagent Trigger text starts with a `[topics: …]` cue; the chat itself keeps the origi"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"nal text.
- Untagged messages use `super-chat:general`, leaving it to Superagent's assessment to acc"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"ept, split or ignore them.
- Agent replies return through the Source Channel. The Channel address ca"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"rries topic ids, so a reply appears in its topic view and in the general chat."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Privacy and security"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- Chats are stored in `chat.sqlite` under `stateDir` and never uploaded by this plugin. Messages rea"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ch the configured model provider like any DSH Session; do not paste secrets into a chat.
- The HTTP "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"API is same-origin with the DSH Web UI and requires `x-super-chat-request: 1`, a matching `Host` and"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" no foreign `Origin`. This is CSRF protection, not authentication; the DSH Web Server still authenti"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"cates the human. Keep it on loopback unless you understand the exposure.
- Superagent Tickets use th"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"e prototype's execution environment and permissions; this plugin writes SQLite, registers the `/supe"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"r-chat` HTTP route, reads Session events and, on an explicit panel save or a worker-model chat direc"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"tive, saves a role model or appends a model selection.
- No analytics, telemetry, remote fonts or ex"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"role model or appends a model selection.
- No analytics, telemetry, remote fonts or external assets."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- Text only; the panel does not accept images or file attachments yet.
- Replies arrive by polling ("},{"id":"p17s2","text":"2.5 s), not token streaming.
- The panel reads the newest 50 messages first and fetches older pages "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"as you scroll up, up to the retained stream limit.
- Topics are labels and dispatch cues, not strict"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" partitions; the first tag chooses the dispatch thread and Superagent may still decide otherwise.
- "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"The fallback has a single Session, so every message shares one model context; tagged replies inherit"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" their turn's tags and appear in both All messages and their matching topic views.
- The plugin does"},{"id":"p17s7","text":" not ship a ticket pipeline or worker pool; those come from `dsh-superagent-prototype`.
- Model sett"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"ings need the prototype; without it the dialog explains that Superagent is unavailable. A chat direc"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"tive only affects a newly created worker Session — a message that joins an existing Ticket keeps tha"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"t worker's model — and names must match a catalog model id or display name (use `provider/model` whe"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"n a bare id is ambiguous). A pending directive is forgotten after 30 minutes.
- Multi-user behavior "},{"id":"p17s12","text":"is limited to what the DSH Web Server already provides.
- The panel uses absolute `/super-chat/api` "},{"id":"p17s13","text":"paths and checks the configured bind host; path-prefix or different-authority reverse proxies are no"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"ecks the configured bind host; path-prefix or different-authority reverse proxies are not supported."}],"truncated":true}
